english: This reading can't be sent now: your last reading is still being checked, or this month's reading is already in. Home shows when you can send the next one.
kinyarwanda: Iki gipimo ntigishobora koherezwa ubu: igipimo giheruka kiracyagenzurwa, cyangwa igipimo cy'uku kwezi cyamaze kwakirwa. Ahabanza herekana igihe mushobora kohereza igikurikiraho.

english: Thank you. You can send your next reading from {date}.
kinyarwanda: Murakoze. Igipimo gikurikiraho mushobora kucyohereza guhera ku wa {date}.

english: A WASAC officer is checking the reading you sent. You can send a new one after the decision; we'll tell you in Messages.
kinyarwanda: Umukozi wa WASAC arimo kugenzura igipimo mwohereje. Mushobora kohereza ikindi nyuma y'icyemezo; tuzabibamenyesha mu Butumwa.

english: The photo you sent on {date} is the first one from your meter. An officer checks it once and saves where your meter is, so later readings go straight through.
kinyarwanda: Ifoto mwohereje ku wa {date} ni yo ya mbere ivuye kuri mubazi yanyu. Umukozi ayigenzura rimwe akabika aho mubazi yanyu iri, bityo ibipimo bizakurikiraho bikemerwa ako kanya.

english: Messages sent through the SMS sandbox, newest first. The sandbox does not reach real phones, so read sign-in codes and notices here.
kinyarwanda: Ubutumwa bwoherejwe binyuze muri SMS y'igerageza, ubwa vuba mbere. Iyi serivisi ntigera kuri telefoni nyazo, bityo kode zo kwinjira n'amatangazo murabisoma hano.

english: No SMS sent through the sandbox yet.
kinyarwanda: Nta SMS iroherezwa muri serivisi y'igerageza.

english: No location on file for this meter yet. Accepting saves where this photo was taken (phone accurate to {accuracy}).
kinyarwanda: Iyi mubazi nta hantu yanditseho. Kwemera bibika aho iyi foto yafatiwe (telefoni yizewe kugera kuri {accuracy}).
